title: Exact inspected build
source_observation: HeyClicky 1.0.51, build 61; minimum macOS 14.2. Internal build plist reports short commit ddbd4191, not a verified public repository ancestry.
metis_adaptation: Bind every comparison to this artifact; do not conflate newer vendor claims with this installation.

title: Native architecture, not recoverable original source
source_observation: Universal Mach-O has x86_64 and arm64 slices and imports SwiftUI, AppKit, ScreenCaptureKit, Speech and PDFKit. No complete original Swift source project was recovered.
metis_adaptation: Implement true native Mac parity and Windows adapters independently. Do not describe packaged instructions as full source.

title: Substantial bundled execution payload
source_observation: Recovered CodexRuntime data forks total 589,486,538 bytes; both Mac architectures are packaged, with Codex and code-mode-host binaries.
metis_adaptation: Use the existing authorized service runner by default. Optional developer runtimes must be licensed, architecture-specific, signed and explicitly selected. Never copy this runtime or its account configuration.

title: Computer-use helper already a separate boundary
source_observation: The helper file exists, and its bundled guidance describes a supervised local MCP computer-use daemon with before/after snapshots. We did not execute it.
metis_adaptation: Evaluate licensed upstream Cua against existing Métis adapters; keep one trusted executor, bounded helper protocol and outcome verification.

title: Fifteen curated runtime skill definitions
source_observation: Fifteen SKILL.md files are present for workflows, documents, developer tasks, design and computer use. Presence alone does not prove availability in an authenticated session.
metis_adaptation: Map each useful capability to centrally governed skill versions rather than copy a second local skills platform.

title: Legacy picker is not the runtime catalog
source_observation: A bundled attribution note explicitly describes a picker whose runtime activation wiring was not included when that note was written. The current binary also ships a different curated skills directory.
metis_adaptation: Keep catalog visibility, selection, entitlement, installation and actual execution distinct. Do not infer current absence solely from possibly stale attribution.

title: Persistent agent identity
source_observation: Packaged guidance gives an agent a durable name, purpose, workspace and conversational identity.
metis_adaptation: AgentDefinition is separate from a model, skill, thread and run; enforce stable ID and version binding in code.

title: Curated agent memory
source_observation: Guidance describes dated, compact job memory and prohibits storing secrets in it.
metis_adaptation: Place memory in authorized canonical records with provenance, correction and deletion; preferences do not become facts or permission.

title: Agent-owned artifacts
source_observation: Guidance assigns new artifacts and temporary generation files to the owning workspace, with explicit export required elsewhere.
metis_adaptation: Use tenant/principal/agent/run scoped artifact handles, safe filenames and atomic publication; verify output independently.

title: Screen content is context, not routing consent

evidence.anchor: Screenshots and the focused app are context

source_observation: Seeing a connected application is not treated as a request to operate its visible UI.
metis_adaptation: Prefer authorized structured connectors or files; distinguish Read, Teach, Draft and Act with their own permissions.

title: Full document can differ from visible screenshot

evidence.inference_limit: Symbol/string presence is not proof this route executes or works.

source_observation: The binary contains an active-document handoff instructing a higher model to use full document text rather than only the visible screenshot; folder usage copy supports that intended path.
metis_adaptation: Implement explicit full/partial/visible-only source coverage, document revision identity and bounded retrieval; never claim universal access to app internals.

title: Document extraction may time out

evidence.inference_limit: Symbol/string presence is not proof this route executes or works.

source_observation: A diagnostic string reports delegating without document context when extraction did not complete.
metis_adaptation: Surface partial coverage; cancel late reads by run generation. Do not silently answer off-screen questions as though full text was read.

title: Minimize protected-folder prompt cascades
source_observation: Instructions discourage speculative probing across several protected personal folders.
metis_adaptation: Ask for the exact needed source or reuse an existing scoped grant. Never scan all Desktop/Documents/Downloads to make onboarding look personalized.

title: Structured schemas and write readback
source_observation: Packaged integration guidance requires schema fidelity and structured verification after writes.
metis_adaptation: Extend existing connector catalog and verifier; a successful HTTP response or connector display name is not business success.

source_observation: A quiet-period symbol exists; exact behavior is supplemented by the versioned vendor changelog, not proven by the symbol.
metis_adaptation: One attention manager respects calls, sharing, Focus/DND and user preferences; agent identity never triggers unrequested audio.

source_observation: Wake/network observers and routine types are present; vendor documentation describes device-bound routine behavior.
metis_adaptation: Declare service-bound versus device-bound tasks, timezone, occurrence keys, missed-run policy, budgets and bounded failures. Never run another desktop device silently.

title: Safe dictation focus and fallback

evidence.anchor: late re-capture found a field in a different app
evidence.inference_limit: Symbol/string presence is not proof this route executes or works.
Symbol/string presence is not proof this route executes or works.

source_observation: Diagnostics describe retaining a clipboard fallback rather than typing into a newly focused application.
metis_adaptation: Pin exact field/window ownership, separate verbatim dictation from rewrite, request clipboard fallback, and avoid overwriting a newer clipboard revision.

title: Avoid capturing the assistant itself
source_observation: A bundled developer note describes excluding its floating assistant window from screenshots.
metis_adaptation: Capture the user-approved target before opening Métis; exclude all Métis windows; never keep resending obsolete screenshots.

title: Durable artifacts need a retrieval surface
source_observation: An artifact skill distinguishes finding/opening/exporting previous outputs from creating new work.
metis_adaptation: Add per-agent result manifests and safe previews, source and output distinctions, download/open failures and exact verified locations.

title: Memory and role do not broaden permissions
source_observation: Guidance explicitly separates remembering job context from external action approval.
metis_adaptation: Permissions are runtime grants, never text in an agent role, memory note, document or skill.

title: The source is not a blanket app license
source_observation: The visible MIT notice belongs to Nous Research skills, with separate attribution for Blender guidance; it does not establish that all HeyClicky application code/media is MIT.
metis_adaptation: Independently implement behavior; review upstream licenses per adopted component. Do not redistribute this DMG, private prompts, mascot, sounds, video, fonts or service configuration in the kit.

title: Unsupported generation routes are explicitly excluded

evidence.anchor: not part of this curated release

source_observation: The installed guidance excludes some provider-backed image/video/slide generation unless exposed by the runtime, despite adjacent legacy guides.
metis_adaptation: Keep existing Métis roadmap abilities, but every agent has a real capability manifest. A skill label cannot create an unavailable provider.

title: Automatic termination is disabled
source_observation: Both metadata flags are false in this build. That is not a tested guarantee against crashes.
metis_adaptation: Native onboarding and run lifecycle must survive windowless moments and shutdown without lying about pending remote tasks.

title: Account, telemetry and updater configuration exists
source_observation: The bundle includes backend, analytics, crash-reporting and updater configuration. The actual content retained by those services was not observed.
metis_adaptation: Do not copy provider IDs or enable those SDKs by implication. Keep Métis metadata-only telemetry and independent signing/feed verification.

title: Intro media is not proof of live automation
source_observation: Eight sampled frames show a person speaking, not a complete executable task sequence. Audio was not transcribed.
metis_adaptation: Produce original Métis onboarding. Keep prerecorded/demo results out of real first-value metrics and capability readiness.

title: Compiled controls are not a live test
source_observation: 127 extracted resource SHA-256 values matched the packaged resource-seal manifest. This validates selected extraction bytes, not Apple signing trust, notarization, runtime safety or app behavior.
metis_adaptation: Record exact evidence level; native acceptance must still run on real installed candidates.
